mapper.select: SELECT asset_id, space_id, asset_name, content, tags FROM wiki_asset WHERE status = '0' AND asset_type = 'WIKI_PAGE' AND COALESCE(tags, '') <> 'SYSTEM_INDEX' ORDER BY asset_id

SELECT asset_id, asset_name, description FROM wiki_asset WHERE status = '0' AND asset_type = 'WIKI_PAGE' AND COALESCE(tags, '') <> 'SYSTEM_INDEX'
AND space_id = #{spaceId} AND space_id IS NULL
ORDER BY asset_name, asset_id

SELECT r.source_asset_id, source.asset_name AS source_name, target.asset_id AS target_asset_id, COALESCE(target.asset_name, r.target_name) AS target_name, r.relation_type FROM wiki_asset_relation r JOIN wiki_asset source ON source.asset_id = r.source_asset_id AND source.status = '0' LEFT JOIN wiki_asset target ON target.asset_id = r.target_asset_id AND target.status = '0'
WHERE r.space_id = #{spaceId} WHERE r.space_id IS NULL
ORDER BY r.source_asset_id, r.source_position, r.relation_id
SELECT DISTINCT space_id FROM wiki_asset_relation WHERE source_asset_id = #{assetId} OR target_asset_id = #{assetId}
SELECT DISTINCT space_id FROM wiki_asset_relation WHERE target_asset_id IS NULL AND LOWER(target_name) = LOWER(#{name})

SELECT a.asset_id, a.space_id, a.asset_name, a.content, a.tags, a.update_time, m.source_json FROM wiki_asset a LEFT JOIN ontology_analysis_memory m ON a.tags = CONCAT('ANALYSIS_MEMORY:', m.memory_id) WHERE a.asset_id = #{assetId} AND a.status = '0' AND a.asset_type = 'WIKI_PAGE'

SELECT asset_id, asset_name FROM wiki_asset WHERE status = '0' AND asset_type = 'WIKI_PAGE' AND COALESCE(tags, '') <> 'SYSTEM_INDEX' AND LOWER(asset_name) IN
LOWER(#{name})
mapper.update: UPDATE wiki_asset_relation SET target_asset_id = #{assetId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE target_asset_id IS NULL AND LOWER(target_name) = LOWER(#{name})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wiki_relation_markdown_index (scope_key, space_id, index_version, markdown_content, generated_at) VALUES (#{scopeKey}, #{spaceId}, #{version}, #{content}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE space_id = VALUES(space_id), index_version = VALUES(index_version), markdown_content = VALUES(markdown_content), generated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT scope_key, space_id, index_version, markdown_content, generated_at FROM wiki_relation_markdown_index WHERE scope_key = #{scopeKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wiki_asset_relation (space_id, source_asset_id, target_asset_id, target_name, relation_type, source_position, source_version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{spaceId}, #{sourceId}, #{targetId}, #{targetName}, #{type}, #{position}, #{sourceVersion}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.source_asset_id, r.target_asset_id, r.target_name, r.relation_type, r.source_position FROM wiki_asset_relation r JOIN wiki_asset source ON source.asset_id = r.source_asset_id AND source.status = '0' LEFT JOIN wiki_asset target ON target.asset_id = r.target_asset_id AND target.status = '0' WHERE (r.target_asset_id IS NULL OR target.asset_id IS NOT NULL) AND r.space_id = #{spaceId} AND (r.source_asset_id IN #{id} OR r.target_asset_id IN #{id}) ORDER BY r.source_asset_id, r.source_position LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wiki_asset_relation r JOIN wiki_asset source ON source.asset_id = r.source_asset_id AND source.status = '0' LEFT JOIN wiki_asset target ON target.asset_id = r.target_asset_id AND target.status = '0' WHERE
r.target_asset_id = #{assetId} r.source_asset_id = #{assetId} (r.source_asset_id = #{assetId} OR r.target_asset_id = #{assetId})
